title: ranunculus philonotis var. parvulus
intro: Ranunculus philonotis var. parvulus, commonly known as Alpine buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine buttercup include its potential to soothe skin irritations, reduce swelling, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus philonotis var. parvulus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
